name: Eternal Flower:Prologue
source:
On her birthday, Scarlet received a pocket watch from her father which he claimed to be the replica of [Chronos Watch], the watch that can turn back the time. Because of that watch, her peaceful days came to the end.

[From [URL=https://altila.itch.io/ef-prolog]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
生日那天，斯嘉丽收到了父亲送给她的一块怀表，他声称这块怀表是【Chronos Watch】的复制品，是一款可以倒流时间的手表。因为那块手表，她平静的日子结束了。

[来自 [URL=https://altila.itch.io/ef-prolog]itch.io[/URL]]
